privacy.privacyIntro: How ScanPlay uses and protects your data.
privacy.privacyDeleteHint: To delete your account, email support@scanplay.org from the address linked to your account.
privacy.privacyPolicy1: ScanPlay (scanplay.org) is published by Bilal El Fahmi to help you study through games. Contact: support@scanplay.org.
privacy.privacyPolicy2: Account data: email, display name, avatar, progress (XP, streak, decks, mistakes, achievements), subscription and preferences (language, theme, sounds).
privacy.privacyPolicy3: Cloud sync via Supabase when signed in. Public profile shared with friends: name, avatar, stats and unlocked achievements.
privacy.privacyPolicy4: Sheet scans: extracted text stays in your history. If AI scan is enabled, images may be processed by OpenAI only to extract vocabulary.
privacy.privacyPolicy5: Multiplayer: room code, scores and lobby presence. Data kept for the duration of the session.
privacy.privacyPolicy6: Your data is not sold. To delete your account, contact support@scanplay.org from your sign-in email. You may also request access to your data at the same address. Session and local preferences are stored in your browser.
privacy.privacyPolicy7: ScanPlay is an independent project created by Bilal El Fahmi. The goal: make studying simpler and more motivating through games, without replacing your course material.
privacy.privacyPolicy8: Progressive web app available at scanplay.org. For questions, feedback or suggestions: support@scanplay.org.
privacy.privacyPolicy9: Plus/Pro subscriptions are billed via Stripe. Plan changes (e.g. Plus → Pro) are only available after your current paid period ends, once automatic renewal is canceled. End and renewal dates are shown in your profile.
privacy.privacyPolicy10: Ads: ScanPlay uses Google AdSense. Google may use cookies to serve and measure ads. You can accept or decline via the on-site cookie banner. Details: scanplay.org/privacy.html
